vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: shrimp-wechat-mp-reader
Version: 0.1.1

The skill is a functional tool designed to scrape and extract text from WeChat Official Account articles using Playwright. It includes automated setup and execution scripts (setup.sh, run.sh, and extract.js) that align with its stated purpose. While the scripts perform automated package installations (npm install) and use hardcoded local paths (e.g., /home/baiwan/...), these behaviors appear to be part of a 'ready-to-run' design rather than indicators of malicious intent. No evidence of data exfiltration, unauthorized remote execution, or harmful prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are coherent with its stated purpose (reading WeChat mp articles via Playwright); it installs Playwright via npm and runs a local browser but does not request unrelated credentials or hidden network endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included files: setup and run scripts plus a Playwright extraction script that navigates to an mp.weixin.qq.com URL and extracts title/body. No unrelated services, credentials, or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the provided setup and run scripts and to read JSON output (title/bodyText). The runtime scripts only access the skill directory, the user's home cache path for Playwright browsers, and the target web page. There is no instruction to read unrelated files, environment variables, or send extracted data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no platform installer, but the included scripts run npm install and npx playwright install chromium. This pulls packages from the public npm registry and downloads browser binaries to the user's cache (~/.cache/ms-playwright). That is expected for Playwright-based tools but is a moderate-risk operation because it writes to disk and performs network downloads from npm and Playwright release infrastructure.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. It only needs a local Node runtime and network access to download packages/browsers and to fetch the target article page — these are proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (default) and the skill does not request permanent system-wide changes. It installs dependencies under the skill directory and browser binaries to the user's cache. It does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it uses Playwright (via npm) to open the provided mp.weixin.qq.com URL and prints title and bodyText as JSON. Before installing, note: (1) you need Node (package.json indicates Node >=18); (2) npm install and npx playwright install will download packages and browser binaries to your machine (~/.cache/ms-playwright); (3) the script launches a visible Chromium instance (headless:false) which may trigger anti-bot or interactive checks on some pages; (4) the code prints page.innerText and does not exfiltrate data to remote endpoints, but you should only run it on content you are permitted to fetch; (5) as with any third-party script, review package.json/package-lock and consider running npm install in an isolated environment if you are unsure.
